subject: Forecast tighten & churn mitigation play
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 14:02:00 +0000
Subject: Forecast tighten & churn mitigation play

Team —

Quick note ahead of EOD: finance is asking us to tighten the renewal commits for Acme (renewal due Jan 31). We need to move 3 accounts from "likely" into either committed or churn-risk buckets by COB Wednesday so FP&A can finalize Q1 subscription revenue.

Please action the items below:

- Laura: update the commit matrix row for Acme with the legal/PO ETA and whether procurement has requested additional terms. Mark as COMMIT if PO date is confirmed; otherwise mark as AT-RISK and add the reason code.
- Rachel: run the churn-risk scoring with the updated usage signals and send the short factsheet for the customer-facing exec (1 pager). Include any recent support escalations.
- Vivek: if we need executive outreach (credit / escalation), confirm availability for a 15-minute sync tomorrow morning and draft the escalation email.

Attachments: renewal_factsheet_Acme_2027.pdf (draft), commit_matrix_acme_2026-12-14.csv (working).

Primary asks (one-liners):
1) Commit status (COMMIT / AT-RISK / CHURN-PIPE) for Acme row in the sheet by 18:00 UTC 2026-12-15.
2) Short factsheet (1 page) with usage delta and support summary by 09:00 UTC 2026-12-15.
3) If AT-RISK, propose the specific mitigation (discount, pilot extension, exec call) and owner.

Thanks — keeping this tight so finance can close the numbers.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Sales Manager, Renewals
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 18:23:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Forecast tighten & churn mitigation play

Aditya —

Quick update on my side: procurement at Acme confirmed the PO approver list but pushed the PO date to Jan 10 pending legal signoff on the new DPA clause. I marked the sheet as AT-RISK for now and added a short note under "blocking item: legal DPA clause" with the contact (Sarah Mitchell, sarah@acme-corp.com).

I attached a snapshot of the commit row (see commit_matrix_acme_2026-12-14.csv) and highlighted the timeline. If legal confirms by Dec 22 I can flip to COMMIT; otherwise we should move to churn mitigation.

Next steps I recommend:
- Rachel: please include the legal delay as part of the churn-risk reason code so we have consistent tagging.
- Vivek: if we escalate, ask legal to accelerate review or offer a temporary data processing addendum (we have a template).

Attachment referenced: commit_matrix_acme_2026-12-14.csv (updated).

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Renewals
Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 08:57:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Forecast tighten & churn mitigation play

On Tue, 14 Dec 2026 at 18:23, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Aditya —
> 
> Quick update on my side: procurement at Acme confirmed the PO approver list but pushed the PO date to Jan 10 pending legal signoff on the new DPA clause. I marked the sheet as AT-RISK for now and added a short note under "blocking item: legal DPA clause" with the contact (Sarah Mitchell, sarah@acme-corp.com).

Thanks Laura — I pulled usage and support signals overnight and ran the churn-risk model against the updated tagging. Summary below: 

- Usage trend (30d): -18% seat-equivalent API calls, heavy drop in non-prod.
- Support: two P2 incidents in last 60d (tickets #5647, #5712) currently resolved but flagged in CS notes.
- Financial: ACME is in the mid-tier cohort with a high renewal dollar impact.

Risk classification: HIGH (needs executive attention) — reasons: usage decline + legal delay + recent P2s.

Attached: renewal_factsheet_Acme_2027.pdf (one-page exec summary) and a short CSV with reason codes. My recommendation: request a legal-exec call and offer a narrowly scoped two-week pilot discount to preserve revenue while legal finalizes the DPA.

Proposed wording for escalation email (feel free to edit):

"Sarah — Appreciate the work on approvals. Given the outstanding DPA review, we'd like to schedule a short legal + commercial call to align on the addendum and propose a two-week pilot extension with a 10% concession to bridge the gap. Can we meet Jan 4 or Jan 5?"

I also linked the HubSpot deal and included the latest CS notes in the Drive brief.

Rachel
Rachel Kim
Renewals Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: renewal_factsheet_Acme_2027.pdf, commit_matrix_acme_2026-12-14.csv

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2026 09:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Forecast tighten & churn mitigation play

Acknowledged. I can join a 15-minute sync tomorrow 08:30 PT / 16:30 UTC.

I like Rachel's recommendation — legal + commercial sync and a narrowly scoped concession to hold ARR. I'll draft the exec escalation email and loop in Legal (cc: legal@redwoodinference.com).

If Laura can flag the exact clause language blocking signoff, I'll push Legal to prioritize.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
